name: Pittacus
bio: Pittacus is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors gives no date for the poet. The attribution is queried by Paton.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 440.

poems.title: Book XI, 440
poems.author: Pittacus
poems.text: Avoid all Megarians, for they are bitter.
